design.residentPool: Lease identities replace arithmetic ownership counts; TTL/LRU use one fresh-facts admission; one async close/notice/cleanup gate. Host registry and persisted data remain host-owned.
design.scriptChild: One channel owns pending replies and sequence; one ALS/counter owner allocates paths; parallel/pipeline share contextual fan-out and per-item failure boundary.
design.customCommand: Lexeme-stream fragments replace per-character escape state; capturing split projects literal/position segments after native all-arguments replacement.

continuous idle TTL resets on a finite earlier touch but not NaN
LRU uses max activity/touch and session-id ties, then stops at target
all residency blockers preserve runtimes, including fresh facts and touch
a new session lease and recursive sampler cannot bypass admission
fact-read errors release the rebalance guard and removal resets idle metadata
duplicate, overlapping and process-only leases release exactly once
synchronous removal precedes a shared gate covering close and notification
sync failures do not decrement capacity and successful notices can fail
gate rejection cleans ownership and a failed acquisition releases process lease
